verdict.summary: The change correctly replaces count-only query-result checks with result-form-specific, engine-independent value comparisons. SELECT preserves bag semantics, ORDER BY is compared modulo legal tie permutations, non-total LIMIT/OFFSET cases remain explicitly cardinality-only, projected headers are checked before classification, blank nodes use table/graph isomorphism, and ASK/graph results can no longer fall through the count path. The added mutation and end-to-end tests exercise the load-bearing paths rather than mocks, including same-cardinality wrong values, multiplicity, ordering ties, window totality from headers, header-only defects, blank-node relabelling, ASK booleans, and count-preserving CONSTRUCT corruption. The documented current generator restrictions keep the text-level form/order extraction and total-tiebreaker policy sound for the generated query surface.
